title: Machine learning predicts distant metastasis in pulmonary sarcomatoid carcinoma
summary: Six machine learning models were built from SEER data to diagnose distant metastasis in pulmonary sarcomatoid carcinoma (589 training, 255 internal test patients); XGBoost performed best on an external Chinese hospital cohort of 94 patients with AUC 0.821. A separate Cox nomogram for cancer-specific survival in metastatic patients reached AUC 0.803 (3-month) and 0.869 (6-month) in a test set of 117. The data are retrospective and the external cohort is small.
ai_technology: Six machine learning models (XGBoost performed best) on logistic-regression-screened risk factors; Cox prognostic nomogram
organization: Southwest Hospital, Third Military Medical University

evidence.tested: Retrospective evaluation on an internal SEER test set and an external Chinese hospital cohort (n=94).
evidence.unknown: Prospective performance and clinical effect are not reported; the prognostic part is a Cox nomogram; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Trained and compared six ML classifiers to identify patients at high risk of distant metastasis.
